Service: joined service-focused online group late 2022-12; shelter food/supplies, toy drive; proposed education/mentoring/job-training/resume projects. 2022 renovated rundown hometown community center, now busy. School career fair 2023-04-01–02 showed resource shortages; sign “Always look on the bright side of life.” School mentor by 2023-08-13: students improving confidence/skills, proud of student's essay that week. Children moved/humbled by memorial visit 2023-07-24–30 (boy with flag in cemetery photo). Organized veterans/families neighborhood 5K 2023-08-05–06: sponsors difficult, contacted businesses, city coordination/publicity, great turnout/funds.
Fire brigade joined by 2023-07-31, inspired by Maria; intense training. First callout 2023-07-30: team rescued family from burning building, adrenaline/purpose, camaraderie like military. 2023-08-16: two-hour donation effort collected canned food/toiletries/clothes; donations obtained new fire truck, Maria contributed; feels true calling.

Mechanical engineering employer failed; job lost by 2023-08-05; possible tech-company hardware role using mechanical skills, no offer confirmed. On 2023-08-11 felt stuck/ineffective; planned list/contact aligned organizations following Maria's advice.
Fitness/travel: kickboxing energizes; taekwondo 2022-12-22. Beginner weekend yoga with colleague Rob by 2023-04-07, daily practice, calm/flexibility/mindfulness; studio offers kickboxing/circuits, tried weights by July. Interested not yet tried rock climbing 2023-06-16. Many camping trips; workmates mountaineering summit 2023-06-05–11. 2022 Pacific Northwest coast/national parks road trip; returned family road trip 2022-12-16. California shore sunset vacation memory. Childhood film camera/beach photos; weekly ocean-sunset walks restore calm. Car windshield incident 2023-01-02–08: calm, sought help, safe; breakdown commuting 2023-04-07 caused repair/financial stress.
Dog Max died by 2023-06-03 after 10 years; family cherishes love/loyalty, considers rescue adoption. Summer 2022 camping/hiking/swimming with Max treasured; photos campfire/tent. Still grieving August.

MARIA
Small supportive family, siblings, friends (movies/hikes/home game nights). Aunt supported financially struggling family, inspired volunteering. Started homeless shelter around 2022-08 after seeing struggling street family. Donated old car 2022-12-21. Comforted lonely ~8-year-old girl without family (recalled January). Charity meals 2023-02-03 met David, referred housing/support organization. Shelter Jean met 2023-02-24: divorced, unemployed, homeless but grateful/optimistic. Gratitude letters from Laura (July) and Cindy (August). Shelter talks praised; organized meal 2023-04-03–09. 5K shelter run 2023-04-01–02. Planned ring-toss fundraiser May, chili cook-off 2023-05-29–06-04; John promised publicity/volunteers. Baked shelter goods 2023-07-24–30. Volunteer medal 2023-07-31–08-06; front desk 2023-08-11 providing food/beds. Shelter feels family; rewarding despite overwhelming need. Dog shelter monthly by June.
Grandmother died 2023-02-27–03-05, difficult grief. Cross necklace by April; joined nearby church 2023-05-05 for faith/community. Church camping 2023-06-10–11; picnic and hike 2023-07-15–16, charades/scavenger hunt, summit peace; community work 2023-08-04.
Car collision 2023-07-02: other driver ran red, everyone okay. Helping female cousin urgently relocate after hardship; John offered resource search.
Creative writing class February; poetry April to express feelings. London trip years earlier inspired castle shadow-box/painting. 2022 solo Spain trip growth/solitude/perspectives, first surfing taught perseverance; beach footprints/island/boat photos. Childhood Oregon family trip waterfall/bridge magical; Florida family sunset memory. December 2022 beach sunset photo shared January. Nature/music/solitude/park walks restore peace.
Aerial yoga since December, loves freeing/light upside-down poses. Gym joined 2023-06-05–11, welcoming friends; goals strength/endurance, trying kundalini; never rock climbed. Self-care exercise/music/loved ones learned through 2022 difficulties. Peach cobbler December; mother dinner 2023-05-03 salads/sandwiches/desserts, favorite banana split. John claimed apple pie that day but photo banana split.
No childhood pets. White female puppy Coco acquired 2023-07-28 (baseball/grass photo); female black shelter puppy Shadow adopted 2023-08-06–12, energetic, learns commands/house-training, gets along with other dog. Both bring joy.
